nom: Bubble Bounce Back Balancing Toner Mist

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination skin report the mist hydrates without leaving skin greasy or heavy, one noting it stays 'slightly shiny, but not oily.'
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe it as hydrating and soothing, several saying it relieved dryness or made dry patches feel like they were 'never there.'
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report balanced, non-greasy hydration when paired with a moisturizer afterward.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: most report no irritation and note the absence of fragrance or a gentle feel, but at least two describe new breakouts, and one used it for someone else who broke out.
segments.mature: One reviewer bought it for a family member and reports skin 'looks amazing' after months of use, without describing specific mature-skin concerns.

concerns.aging: Only indirect mentions exist (a grandmother reporting a relative's skin 'looks amazing' after months of use); no reviewer describes lines, firmness, or aging-specific results.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers report strong, lasting hydration and a refreshed, non-sticky feel; one reviewer with dry skin says other mists dried her skin out but this one did not.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report reduced redness or calmed inflammation, including one who says it works when cleansing and moisturizing alone were not enough; no dissent found.
concerns.barrier: Not clearly discussed by reviewers as a distinct concern beyond general hydration and calming effects.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report blackheads, hormonal acne, or blemishes improving or clearing with regular use, including one tracking visible healing over 10 days; dissent exists as a few report the product made no difference or worsened spots.
concerns.blemishes: Multiple reviewers report breakouts clearing or old blemishes fading, some crediting it with dramatic overnight improvement; however, at least three reviewers (including sensitive and oily/acne-prone skin) report new bumps or breakouts after use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers report the mist leaves skin hydrated without oiliness or greasiness, describing a 'glowy' but not oily finish; no dissent found.

extraits.texte: I bought this product like a week ago and to be honest I havent seen much of a difference at all. Im still going to continue to use this but im not sure ill see a visible difference. I have acne prone and oily skin. Im sure its doing a difference deep in my skin thats just not visible. But I recommend this for other people despite my issues anyways!

extraits.titre: I wanted to love this but…
extraits.texte: I really wanted to love this, but since I have sensitive skin, it could just be my skin personally, but it made me break out, but it is super hydrating
I have super dry sensitive skin and this never causes irritation. It makes my skin feel super refreshed.
I've repurchased this 3+ times . Liveit for jy sensitive dry skin bc it has no fragrance and light on my face

extraits.titre: Will absolutely buy this toner again.
extraits.texte: I'm 31yrs old with PCOS so I deal with hormonal acne. BC has calmed down my skin mainly, however, I was still dealing with with blackheads and pimples. I didn't want to keep cycling products so I took a chance on this toner. I could already see a difference after 10 days. This is 100% worth it. I also love that it is a spray bottle. My only critique is that the bottle is small. I try to use it only at night with 3 spritz max (I'll use it during the day if I feel like my face needs it). Love, love, love this toner though. I can actually see my skin healing.

I can't praise it enough. I have red, dry inflammation that cleansing, exfoliating and moisturizing isn't enough to combat. And when the bottle says "instant reset"? Honey, it MEANS it! Only problem is I can't stop spraying it! It's so refreshing.
I love this!!!!! One of my favorite products by far! It has made such a difference with my acne. It doesn't dry my face out but it does help dry acne out. Love it!
